name: Illarion Morarenko
person_note: taken across while drunk by fellow villager Iosif Votsura; handed back by Romania on 15 June and released
narrative: On 28 February three unknown people broke through to the right bank and were fired on without result. Later reports identified them as Illarion Morarenko, kolkhoznik, 24, and Ivan Iurkovskii, 16, low-income seredniak, both of Shmalena, Rybnitsa raion, who were taken across while drunk by their fellow villager Iosif Votsura, bedniak; he stayed on the right bank, where he has relatives. The Romanian delegate handed Morarenko and Iurkovskii back on 15 June and they were released.

name: Anton Dmitrievich Venger
narrative: On the 15th of March at 23:00 in the Rybnitsa area, deserted to the right bank a Red Army soldier of the UNR guard (company 1032) [...] born in 1909, member of the Komsomol, miner from Ranenburg Region. Venger's desertion to the right bank was committed while he was on duty as a sentry guarding the UNR facility No. 269. The moment of Venger's crossing to the right bank was noticed by a replacement Red Army soldier of the same facility Romanov. The latter, in order to prevent Venger's desertion to the right bank, opened fire on Venger from a rifle, to which he responded with two shots from the right bank. Red Army soldier Venger had a weapon with him. A guard detachment of the Rybnitsa outpost was located 450 meters from this facility, and they did not notice the external demarcations. An investigation is underway.

name: I. I. Sidorov
person_note: reached the right bank; beaten and forced back at gunpoint by the Romanian guard
narrative: According to the legal data of the INO, on March 15, at 8 o'clock, in the area of ​​the city of Tiraspol', Sidorov I. I., a former officer, crossed from the left to the right bank. Having been detained by the guards of the right bank and taken to the picket "Migai-Vityaz", he stated that he was an officer of the former tsarist army, was escaping from the Bolshevik hell and that he had extensive connections among prominent people in Romania. The picket chief, without giving Sidorov any explanations or answers, ordered him to immediately return to the left bank. When Sidorov categorically refused to return, the picket chief barked at the platoon commander, from whom he received orders to forcefully expel the violators back. The platoon commander's orders were carried out to the letter. Sidorov was severely beaten, pushed onto the ice and forced at gunpoint to return to the left bank.

name: Vasilii Kozhukhar'
person_note: crossed unseen; handed back by Romania on 15 June and released
narrative: On 15 June the Romanian delegate handed back people who had crossed during the winter, among them Vasilii Kozhukhar'', 18, bedniak, Komsomol member; Anna Gotskan with her daughter Evdokiia and sons Zakharii and Ivan, bedniaks; Pavel Alekseev, 21, farmhand, Komsomol member, and his wife Paraskeva — all of Malovata, Dubossary raion (zastava 17), who had crossed to the right bank on 15 March at 20:00 together with fellow villagers Leontii Opria, bedniak, with his wife Mariia, son Afanasii and daughter Aleksandra; Ekaterina Timush, 20, bedniachka; and Nataliia Opria, 40, bedniachka, with her sons Gavriil, 16, and Iustin, 12, and an infant. These last were left on the right bank. One to two hours later, on the same sector, Luk'ian Batrincha, 50, bedniak, with his daughter Anis'ia, 18, and Afanasii Alekseev, bedniak, with his wife Dar'ia and three small children crossed; they too were left on the right bank. Reason for crossing: food shortage. An investigation into these unpunished breakthroughs is under way.

narrative: On 15 June the Romanian delegate handed back people who had crossed during the winter, among them Vasilii Kozhukhar'', 18, bedniak, Komsomol member; Anna Gotskan with her daughter Evdokiia and sons Zakharii and Ivan, bedniaks; Pavel Alekseev, 21, farmhand, Komsomol member, and his wife Paraskeva — all of Malovata, Dubossary raion (zastava 17), who had crossed to the right bank on 15 March at 20:00 together with fellow villagers Leontii Opria, bedniak, with his wife Mariia, son Afanasii and daughter Aleksandra; Ekaterina Timush, 20, bedniachka; and Nataliia Opria, 40, bedniachka, with her sons Gavriil, 16, and Iustin, 12, and an infant. These last were left on the right bank. One to two hours later, on the same sector, Luk'ian Batrincha, 50, bedniak, with his daughter Anis'ia, 18, and Afanasii Alekseev, bedniak, with his wife Dar'ia and three small children crossed; they too were left on the right bank. Reason for crossing: food shortage. An investigation into these unpunished breakthroughs is under way.

name: Matrena Mel'nik
narrative: On the 17th of March at 12 o'clock in the region of Strointsy, a patrol consisting of the border guard Zhelezniakov caught 2 women crossing from the left to the right bank. The patrol fired 6 shots from 500 steps away. The violators were on the right bank when one of them was shot in the leg. In the process of shooting the violators, Zhelezniakov was shot once from a rifle from the right bank. In this case, two citizens of Strointsy broke through to the right bank - [...] - their reason for going was to look for bread.

name: Evgenii Kishkat
narrative: On the 27th of March at 13:00 in the Glinnoe area at checkpoint-4 the young border guard Artemovii spotted two individuals carefully creeping towards the demarcation.When he shouted out to them, they began to run towards the right bank. As a result of the decisive use of [his] weapon, one was killed on the left bank and the other was captured. The killed turned out to be an employee of the UNR - Evgenii Kishkat and the captured turned out to be a deserter from the Red Army's 151st rifle division Leonid Platonov. From the interrogation of Platonov, we found out that he deserted from the rifles on the 25th of March together with Dmitrii Tansii and Grigorii Kozhukhar', with the aim of escaping to the right bank due to the difficult material conditions of their families. The leader of the group turned out to be Grigorii Kozhukhar' - a citizen of Korotnoe. As a result of the capture of Platonov, the following red army soldiers together with their families were also captured... [...].

narrative: On the 2nd of April at 21:00 in the Speia area at checkpoint-3, a patrol, hiding in secret, led by Kirilovii, with the help of the search dog "Venger", came across a group of unknown people from our side crossing the demarcation. Shining a spotlight on the group of violators, it turned out to be a group of 4 people. They were called out to, at which point none of them stopped and they began to run in different directions across the demarcation. In order to catch the violators, the leader let the dog "Venger" off the leash and also opened fire on them from his rifle. The whole group was caught. Prior to being captured, Evdokiia Bernover, 43, bedniak was killed by gunfire [as was] Zakharii, 17 bedniak... Vasilisa Lupulova was heavily injured and taken to hospital... Evgeniia Samoilova was heavily injured and taken to hospital... The violators were captures in the region of the left bank of the Dniester. According to protocol, the weapons were used correctly. The investigation is ongoing.

narrative: At night on the 13th of June in the Rybnitsa area representatives of the Rybnitsa Selsoviet - Lipatov and instructor of the raion fruit-and-vegetable union Todosii, both members of the Communist Party, crossed from the left to the right bank. On June 12, the above-mentioned persons were charged in the investigative order with a number of official crimes committed, as well as distortions of the party's policy in the village. The measure of restraint chosen for them was to remain at large until the Court's decision. This, almost certainly, was their reason for fleeing to the right bank...

name: Sekleteia Koksha
person_note: tried to swim across; reason for crossing: acute food shortage
narrative: On the 15th of June at 1am a patrol in the Glinnoe area consisting of Utomovii, born in 1909, saw one man and one woman trying to float from the left to the right bank. He called out to them, and after they ignored him, he began to shoot from his rifle. The woman swam back and was captured, but the man continued to the right bank under fire. The captured turned out to be the citizen of Glinnoe, [...], bedniak, 15. The one who made it to the right bank was also a citizen of Glinnoe, [...], a seredniak, 24. Their reason for fleeing was a lack of food. The main reason that the shooting failed was the fog, [which prevented the shooting successfully at a distance of only 70-100 metres in the 'night conditions'].

name: unknown
person_note: talking across the river with a Romanian guard; fled into the Soviet rear, possibly wounded
narrative: On June 19, at 19 o'clock, the lookout of the Chobruchi outpost - border guard NICHVOLOD noticed an unknown man 600 meters away, talking from the left bank with one Romanian border guard, who was on the right bank of the Dniester River. During the surrounding search for the unknown, the lookout was noticed by a Romanian border guard, who called out to the unknown as the lookout approached. The unknown immediately fled and disappeared in our rear, having been fired upon in vain by 3 shots fired by a soldier, after precautionary measures for detention. On the way of escape - traces of blood were found. But the possibility that the hiding man was wounded is excluded.

name: Vladimir Alekseevich Chernyshev
person_note: tried to float across on three football bladders; reason given: 'thirst for travel'
narrative: On 20 June at 24:00, on the sector of zastava 29, a patrol noticed two men lying near the demarcation; after a warning shot they were detained. Both were residents of Moscow: Georgii Anatol'evich Elizarov, b. 1910, clerk-translator of the Scientific-Methodological Committee of Narkompros RSFSR, a graduate of the Moscow Institute of New Languages, whose father, a former second lieutenant in the tsarist army and regimental commander in the Red Army, now works as a bookkeeper in a Moscow state printing house; and Vladimir Alekseevich Chernyshev, b. 1909, bookkeeper at the OGIZ publishing house, with secondary education, whose mother works as a ticket inspector in a Moscow cinema. They had tried to cross the Dniester using three football bladders. Reason for crossing: 'thirst for travel'. They have no relatives abroad and are not under suspicion.

name: David Davidovich Maier
person_note: watching the opposite bank from bushes; declared himself a Trotskyist who had once planned to kill Stalin; sister in Romania
narrative: On the 21st of June at 17:00 the patrol of the Tiraspol' region, led by border guard Nersan Bodrov (born in 1908) noticed one unknown man looking out from behind the bushes at the location of the guard patrol and observing the opposite side. The border guard caught him. Upon interrogation, it was determined that the captured was [...]. On the purpose of his crossing to the Right Bank, Maier said that he considered himself to be a Trotskyist; in all fields he considered himself to be an enemy of Comrade Stalin; so that in September 1930 he left Marx, Volga region, to go to Moscow with the goal of killing Comrade Stalin, for which reason he had purchased a nagant revolver. For 5 days he watched the Kremlin and quickly tracked comrade Stalin, but he was unable to see the latter and, noticing "suspicious" persons around him and, taking them for OGPU agents, he disappeared. After this incident, he made no attempts to fulfill his intention. When asked whether he would cross over to the Soviet side on assignment from the Romanian intelligence service to carry out the same task, Maier replied that he would do so with pleasure. Maier's sister lives in Romania, but he does not know exactly where. The Moldovan Department petitions for a reward for border guard Bodrov for the detention of the violator Maier.

narrative: On the same day at 23:00 in the city of Slobodzeia at section 35, border guards found a float which had been prepared to cross to the right bank to reunite with her husband. The float was built by her husband who had left before her…

name: unknown

narrative: On 24 June at 14:00 a sentry of the Chobruchi zastava found a set of men's underwear on the left bank. In all probability one unknown person broke through to the right bank here.

name: Duduv
person_note: turned back to the left bank and was shot while running
narrative: On the 25th of June at 12 in the area of Nezavertailovka, patrolman Tikhopovii saw 300 metres away one unknown man heading to the right bank with a float. The patrolman tried to call attention to the unknown man, who rushed into the Dniester and tried to cross to the other side. As a result of the border guard using his weapon, the unknown began to turn back to the left bank, where he then tried to run away from the patrolman. The patrolman... [chased him] and decisively used his weapon - killing the violator. The deceased turned out to be the citizen of Nezavertailovka - Duduv, a 20 year old kulak. An investigation is ongoing into the use of weaponry.

name: unknown
person_note: exchanged fire with the sentry and escaped into the Soviet rear; suspected Romanian agent
narrative: On 25 June at 01:00, near Goiany (zastava 16), a Red Army sentry of the UNR guard saw an unknown man creeping towards the Dniester from the Soviet rear. After warnings he was fired on; he fired back several times with a revolver, putting one bullet through the sentry's cap, and escaped into the Soviet rear. A search found nothing. He may have been a Romanian intelligence agent trying to get back to the right bank.

name: Grigorii Vornik
person_note: widower; crossed with his five children, apparently in a large box he built in the orchards near the demarcation; box seen on the right bank
narrative: On the 26th of June at midday on the right bank near the village of Chobruchi, the border guards found a large crate. Upon inspecting the area, on the left bank there were footsteps from the box leading back to a garden that backed onto the Dniester. At this point, 300 metres from the bank, we found nails and a hammer. It was eventually established that at night on the 26th of June at that point, the citizen of Chobruchi Grigorii Vornik, 45, a seredniak, crossed the river in the crate with his 5 children. It seems Vornik crossed with his family to the other bank... The investigation into the violation of the demarcation is ongoing.
